observations: Photo 0 shows a black Lumix mirrorless camera body with a lens attached, mode dial, and partial charger on a blue cloth.
Photo 1 shows the same camera with the flip-out screen open displaying "Please set the clock", one Lumix battery, and one charger on a blue cloth.
"LUMIX" is readable on the camera top plate in photo 0 and on the charger in photo 1.
No "G7" model marking is visible in either photo.
Only one battery is visible in photo 1, though the seller claims two.

photo 1 shows one battery and one charger; a second battery is not visible

risks.proof: Video of the camera turning on, navigating menus, and taking a photo

risks.risk: Image sensor has dust, fungus, or damage
risks.proof: Photo of the sensor with the lens removed, or through the lens at a bright surface

risks.risk: Lens has fungus, haze, or separation
risks.proof: Photo looking through the front and rear lens elements
Video of a battery charging and powering the camera
Video of the charger indicator light with a battery inserted

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, navigating the menu, and taking a photo
Photo of the model label on the camera base or in the menu to confirm G7
Video of the charger charging a battery
Photo looking through the lens elements for fungus or haze
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used Lumix mirrorless camera with lens; the G7 model and second battery are only claimed by the seller, so it can be priced at its worst case as an untested Lumix mirrorless with one battery and charger.
